name: How much square footage is required for a bathroom addition?
description: A half bath requires 18 to 30 square feet, a standard full bath needs 35 to 40 square feet, and a primary master bathroom typically needs 60 to 100 square feet.

mainEntity.name: How much square footage is required for a bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding a half bath requires roughly 18 to 30 square feet, which accommodates a toilet and small vanity. A full bathroom featuring a tub-shower combination or walk-in shower generally requires at least 35 to 40 square feet. If you plan an expansive primary suite bathroom with a double vanity, separate shower, and private water closet, expect to designate 60 to 100 square feet or more. Before planning, measure surrounding closets, hallway niches, or adjacent bedroom space to determine if you have sufficient interior footage or need an exterior addition.
